content.description: Installation of power steering pump onto bracket, showing PS pump, pulley, and drive belt assembly

content.text: 9. INSTALL POWER STEERING PUMP ONTO BRACKET

items: (a) Install the PS pump and stay.
(b) Install the PS pump pulley with the drive belt.
(c) Adjust the belt tension by prying until the specified belt tension is obtained. (See page MA-8)
(e) Tighten the idler pulley nut and adjusting bolt.

content.description: Installation of intake manifold onto cylinder head with bolts and nuts

items: (a) Position a new gasket on the cylinder head.
(b) Install the intake manifold with eight bolts and two nuts. Torque the bolts and nuts.

content.text: 11. CONNECT EFI WIRE HARNESS TO ECU

content.description: Installation of water outlet housing with water by-pass hose and clamp

items: (a) Install the water outlet housing with two bolts.
(b) Connect the water by-pass hose and tighten the clamp.

content.text: 13. INSTALL NO. 1 FUEL PIPE AND PULSATION DAMPER

items: (a) Finger tighten the pulsation damper and union bolt with new gaskets on the fuel pipe.
(b) Tighten the fuel pipe, being careful not to bend it.

content.description: Installation of air intake chamber onto intake manifold with bolts, nuts, and EGR valve connecting pipe

items: (a) Position a new gasket on the intake manifold.
(b) Install the air chamber with five bolts and two nuts. Torque the bolts and nuts.
(c) Tighten the nut of the EGR valve connecting pipe.

content.description: Connection of cold start injector fuel hose to delivery pipe with gaskets and union bolt

content.text: 15. CONNECT COLD START INJECTOR FUEL HOSE TO DELIVERY PIPE
Install the new gasket, fuel hose, another gasket and union bolt to the delivery pipe.
